correctness.rationale: The upper bound uses an explicit \(2r+1\)-square decomposition. For the lower bound, projecting the span of all candidate squares to \(\operatorname{Sym}^2(V^*)\) gives \(\dim S\ge r+1+\dim\pi(S)\); the mixed terms force the projected linear parts to span \(V^*\), and \(r\) independent linear forms have independent squares. Hence every decomposition has at least \(2r+1\) summands.
